@graph.name: Vidya LLC
@graph.description: Vidya LLC provides legacy system modernization, IT consulting, and technology training services, spanning application code, data architecture, and agile and DevSecOps culture. We're an 8(a) & SWaM certified small business dedicated to helping organizations leverage technology for growth.

itemListElement.name: AI Consulting & Agentic Engineering
itemListElement.description: Vidya builds agentic AI systems for business and government on Spring AI, Embabel, MCP, and LangChain4j, engineered for production use.

itemListElement.name: Legacy System Modernization
itemListElement.description: Vidya modernizes legacy government and commercial systems incrementally, covering application code, data architecture, and delivery culture, the approach behind the State Department's Online Passport Renewal and the Recreation.gov migration.

itemListElement.name: Cloud Native Architecture & DevSecOps
itemListElement.description: Vidya builds cloud-native, container-based systems on AWS and Azure with DevSecOps pipelines that shipped the State Department's passport service and tripled Recreation.gov's reservation volume.

itemListElement.name: Software & Data Architecture
itemListElement.description: Vidya designs event-driven microservices, Zero Trust access, and Data Mesh architectures, the same discipline behind a React component library used across 6 State Department product teams.

itemListElement.name: Technology Culture & Organizational Consulting
itemListElement.description: Vidya builds engineering culture, contracting, and recruiting practices beyond Scrum ceremony, backed by GAO Agile Expert Group membership and the training program that became DITAP.

itemListElement.name: AI & Modernization Consulting for Government
itemListElement.description: Vidya is an 8(a) and SWaM-certified firm on GSA MAS schedule 47QTCA24D0069 (SIN 54151S), delivering modernization and AI work for the State Department and other federal agencies.

itemListElement.name: Vidya LLC Technology Training Courses
itemListElement.description: Enhance your team's skills with our comprehensive technology training programs. We offer courses in software development, data engineering, and agile methodologies tailored to your specific needs.

itemListElement.name: Vidya LLC Blog
itemListElement.description: Explore Vidya LLC's blog for insightful articles, industry news, and expert insights on legacy system modernization, IT consulting, technology training, and more.

itemListElement.name: Free Online Tutorials
itemListElement.description: Access Vidya LLC's library of software development tutorials. Explore our free educational content covering various technologies, tools, and best practices.
